param: π Human population birth/recruitment rate
k Fraction of human births vaccinated (vaccination coverage at recruitment); reported range 0.60–0.90
μ₁ Human natural death rate
μ₂ Mosquito natural death rate
Λ Mosquito population birth/recruitment rate
ε Vaccine efficacy; reported range 0.3–0.5
θ Vaccine immunity loss rate; reported range 0.1–0.2
τ₁ Progression rate: vector-exposed humans (E_H1) to infectious humans (I_H)
τ₂ Progression rate: non-vector-exposed humans (E_H2) to infectious humans (I_H)
σ Progression rate: infectious humans (I_H) to treated humans (T_H)
ω Progression rate: treated humans (T_H) to recovered humans (R_H)
γ Immunity loss rate: recovered humans (R_H) to susceptible humans (S_H)
δ₁ Disease-induced death rate for humans (applies to I_H and T_H per paper's NH equation)
ηᵥ Effective contact rate: vaccinated humans with infected mosquitoes (mosquito-to-human) via bites; range 0.001–0.005
ηₛ Effective contact rate: susceptible humans with infected mosquitoes (mosquito-to-human) via bites; range 0.005–0.02
ξᵥ Effective contact rate: vaccinated humans with infected humans via non-vector pathways; range 0.0005–0.002
ξₛ Effective contact rate: susceptible humans with infected humans via non-vector pathways; range 0.001–0.003
ρ Effective contact rate: susceptible mosquitoes with infected humans via bloodmeals; range 0.01–0.05
φ Progression rate: exposed mosquitoes (E_M) to infectious mosquitoes (I_M)
β₁ Force of infection on vaccinated humans from infectious mosquitoes (before efficacy factor in Eq. (2)-(3))
β₂ Force of infection on susceptible humans from infectious mosquitoes
α₁ Force of infection on vaccinated humans from infectious humans via non-vector pathways
α₂ Force of infection on susceptible humans from infectious humans via non-vector pathways
β₃ Force of infection on susceptible mosquitoes from infectious humans
